**Points:** 1  
**Mandatory for Certification:** No  
**Project types:** Print, Digital, Hybrid  
**Related SDGs:** SDG 8, SDG 9, SDG 10, SDG 11

## Description

## Why it matters
Design with open content that is freely available for use, adaptation, and distribution under specific conditions set by the creator.
